faq.q: Is Aaid a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aaid is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aaid written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aaid is written عيد in Arabic and عید in Urdu, and ईद in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aaid?

faq.q: Which names are related to Aaid?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aaid include Aaeedah, Aaidun.

faq.q: Why is a festival called ʿīd?
faq.a: Because it returns or recurs each year; the word ʿīd comes from the root ʿ-w-d, 'to return'.
